data.gender_notes: किरण is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name किरण is derived from the Sanskrit language. It refers to a ray of light or radiance. In Hindu mythology, Kirana is the name of a celestial being, a ray of light sent by the god Indra to illuminate the darkness. It is also a name of the god Vishnu, representing his divine light. The name किरण carries the meaning “Ray of light, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose किरण usually hope their child will grow to embody ray of light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine light and illumination.
data.etymology: किरण belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ray of light, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of किरण total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: Kirana Tantra, a classical Hindu text on Alchemy and Ayurveda, mentions the term 'Kirana' as a manifestation of Shiva. It is believed that Kirana represents the radiant, fiery, and transformative aspect of the deity.
Another reference to the name 'Kirana' is found in the Mahabharata, where it is used as a synonym for Arjuna, signifying his radiant and brilliant qualities.
